# Word candidates for the Topic scheme

<!-- GENERATED by docs/recommendations-research/term-candidates.mjs. Do not edit by hand: re-run it. -->

Single words the published prose supports, which are **not yet a vocabulary label**: the one-word counterpart of `bigram-candidates.md`, from the same documents, as an input to taxonomy revision 1.

Generated 2026-10-29 from `recommendations-lab`, from 73 documents with prose against 89 vocabulary labels. 182 candidates; the top 120 are below, and `word-candidates.csv` has them all.

## How to read this

**keyword docs** is the score: how many documents the word is one of the 25 most distinctive words of, by the TF-IDF the search index uses. A word every document uses scores nothing; a word several documents lean on scores high. **docs** and **uses** count every appearance. **in labels** names existing labels the word already sits inside, which can make it a candidate for a broader concept rather than a new one.

Expect noise. The tokenizer, floors and exclusions are the bigram list's own; only the score differs, because G² needs two words.

## Thresholds

A word must occur at least 3 times, across at least 2 documents, and be one of the top 25 keywords of at least 2 documents. Counted 6,618 distinct words.
